connector.name: TCG MCP
connector.registryDescription: Pokemon TCG MCP server: PSA grading, collection management, and multi-provider pricing.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tcg-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the seanlok account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PSA_API_TOKEN
env.description: PSA Public API bearer token. Get one at https://www.psacard.com/publicapi. If unset, PSA tools are disabled but other tools (Pokemon TCG API, collection, watchlist) still work.

env.name: POKEMONTCG_API_KEY
env.description: Pokemon TCG API key (optional). Without it the provider still works at a lower rate limit. Free key: https://dev.pokemontcg.io/

env.name: PRICECHARTING_TOKEN
env.description: PriceCharting API token (paid subscription required). Enables graded-card pricing.

env.name: TCG_DB_PATH
env.description: Where to put the local SQLite database. Default: ~/.tcg-mcp/tcg.db
